name: BLD Plantation Bhd.
summary: BLD Plantation Bhd., an investment holding company, engages in the palm oil business in China, Bangladesh, Africa, India, Korea, Malaysia, Pakistan, and internationally. The company is involved in the cultivation of oil palms; operation of a palm oil refinery and kernel crushing plant; and processing of fresh fruit bunches, and sale of related products. It also engages in letting of property; and provision of management and security services. In addition, the company is involved in cattle farming and goat rearing, compost, and stone quarrying activities. BLD Plantation Bhd. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kuching, Malaysia.
